page: Amazon Web Services c8id.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 48 dedicated vCPUs derived from 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor operating at 3.9 GHz. The processor includes a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE and AMX_INT8) for accelerated matrix operations. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

For local storage, the instance includes 2850 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, providing high-speed local data access. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 22 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c8id.12xlarge offers a dense allocation of high-frequency compute cores and fast DDR5 memory alongside substantial local NVMe storage, making it a resource-dense option for workloads requiring high local I/O performance without the overhead of network-attached storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across multiple domains. The instance achieves top-tier status in Geekbench single-core, image processing, and text processing tests, alongside strong results in multi-core processing, software compilation, and ray tracing. Memory read bandwidth is highly efficient, scoring in the top 25% for both small and large blocks. Database operations, Redis SET performance, and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 25%. These characteristics make the c8id.12xlarge highly suitable for compute-intensive workloads, software development pipelines, high-throughput web serving, local database hosting, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
description: Amazon Web Services c8id.12xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of DDR5 memory and 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, managed by the Nitro hypervisor. The processor supports advanced vector and matrix extensions (AVX-512 and AMX), contributing to top-tier single-core, image processing, and text processing performance in benchmarks. With a baseline network bandwidth of 22 Gbps and strong memory read bandwidth, this instance delivers high throughput for data-intensive operations. The c8id.12xlarge is well-suited for high-performance computing, software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and low-latency local storage workloads.
